qualification.description: Teams must have at least five verified games to qualify for rankings.

division_guardrails.description: Tier 3 teams should never appear in the Top 10.
Tier 3 teams should not appear in the Top 15.
Tier 2 teams should not appear in the Top 10.
Tier 2 teams in the Top 15 require strong evidence.

club_hierarchy.description: A team should usually be ranked above B, and B above C, unless the lower team has substantial quality-win evidence.
